description: This Scala source file defines the Catalogs object responsible for loading and configuring catalog plugins in Apache Spark SQL. It includes methods for dynamically loading catalog classes, handling configuration options, and error handling related to catalog instantiation.

classes.name: Catalogs
classes.description: Object responsible for loading and configuring catalog plugins in Spark SQL.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads, instantiates, and initializes a catalog plugin by name, handling various exceptions if the class cannot be found or instantiated.

methods.name: catalogOptions
methods.description: Extracts catalog-specific configuration options from SQLConf, returning a case-insensitive map of options.
